## How verified

- [ ] Local gate passes: `./gradlew :app:ktlintCheck :app:detekt :app:lintDebug test :app:koverVerifyDebug :app:assembleDebug`
- [ ] New or changed behavior has tests
- [ ] Tried on a device or emulator (if the UI changed)

## Checklist

- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` updated under `## [Unreleased]` (or not needed)
- [ ] Docs updated; `README.md` changed in both English and Italian (if touched)
- [ ] No secrets, tokens or personal data in code, tests, logs or screenshots
